Description
This 2023 Volkswagen Golf TSI R presents an exceptional ownership proposition with a mere 10,141 miles on the clock, a testament to its single owner and careful use. This Euro 6 compliant model boasts a potent 2.0 litre petrol engine paired with a four wheel drive system, offering both performance and assured handling. Inside, you'll find the intuitive Discover Navigation Infotainment System complete with Bluetooth connectivity, alongside a convenient wireless smartphone charger. For enhanced driving comfort and safety, it features Adaptive Cruise Control and a three zone electronic climate control system, all accessible with the ease of keyless entry and a start stop button. The performance of this Golf TSI R is truly remarkable, capable of accelerating from 0 to 62 miles per hour in just 4.7 seconds, a figure that sets it apart from many other vehicles in its class. This rapid acceleration, combined with its impressive boot space, makes it a versatile choice for both spirited driving and everyday practicality. The low mileage and single owner history further underscore its excellent condition and desirability, offering a compelling package for any discerning driver.
